-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.SpecResults` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def RestoreResult (id : w64) (s : NState) (sv : SnapshotM) (cl : CSLists) (b : Bool) (s' : NState) :
    Prop :=
  have ls := s.logst;
  have es := ls.sents ++ ls.uents;
  have sid := snapId sv;
  (uint.Z sid.index' ≤ uint.Z ls.committed ∨ ¬cl.Has id) ∧ b = false ∧ s' = s ∨
    uint.Z ls.committed < uint.Z sid.index' ∧
        cl.Has id ∧
          PlogMatches ls.prev es sid ∧
            b = false ∧
              s' =
                { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox,
                  stepfn := s.stepfn, ticking := s.ticking, progress := s.progress, log := s.log,
                  logst :=
                    { prev := ls.prev, sents := ls.sents, uents := ls.uents, committed := sid.index',
                      applied := ls.applied, snap := ls.snap, inprogress := ls.inprogress, applying := ls.applying,
                      unpersisted := ls.unpersisted, stored := ls.stored, apsize := ls.apsize, apmax := ls.apmax,
                      storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn, fl := ls.fl, sip := ls.sip, lent := ls.lent, sapp := ls.sapp,
                      aps := ls.aps, sat := ls.sat, sxt := ls.sxt },
                  prvals := s.prvals, prevote := s.prevote, gh := s.gh, rd := s.rd, lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci,
                  isLearner := s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq } ∨
      uint.Z ls.committed < uint.Z sid.index' ∧
        cl.Has id ∧
          ¬PlogMatches ls.prev es sid ∧
            b = true ∧
              s' =
                { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox,
                  stepfn := s.stepfn, ticking := s.ticking, progress := s.progress, log := s.log,
                  logst := logRestore ls (snapTrip sv cl), prvals := s.prvals, prevote := s.prevote, gh := s.gh,
                  rd := s.rd, lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci, isLearner := s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq }

def LocalApplyThread : w64 :=
  W64 18446744073709551614

def MsgStorageApplyResp : w32 :=
  W32 22

def snapCfg (sv : SnapshotM) (cl : CSLists) : CfgM :=
  csCfgM cl.outgoing cl.voters cl.learners cl.learnersNext sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.AutoLeave'

def SnapScopeIf (id : w64) (sv : SnapshotM) (cl : CSLists) : Prop :=
  (cl.Has id → SnapScope sv cl) ∧ uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' < 2 ^ 61

def HupGuard [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s s' : NState) : Prop
    :=
  s' = s ∨
    s.role ≠ PRole.leader ∧
      id ∈ c.voters ∧
        s.logst.snap = none ∧
          (¬∃ e, e ∈ unappliedEnts s.logst ∧ IsConfEnt e) ∧
            ∃ pre peers pvs cl,
              peers.Perm (elements (c.voters \ {id})) ∧
                s' =
                  have __src := campaignState id s pre peers cl;
                  { term := __src.term, vote := __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes,
                    outbox := __src.outbox, stepfn := __src.stepfn, ticking := __src.ticking, progress := __src.progress,
                    log := __src.log, logst := __src.logst, prvals := pvs, prevote := __src.prevote, gh := __src.gh,
                    rd := __src.rd, lt := __src.lt, pci := __src.pci, isLearner := __src.isLearner, sdr := __src.sdr,
                    cq := __src.cq }

def unappliedEnts (ls : LogState) : List EntryM :=
  scanRange ls (ls.applied + W64 1) (ls.committed + W64 1)

def LocalAppendThread : w64 :=
  W64 18446744073709551615

def HupOkC [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s s' : NState) : Prop :=
  NStateWf s' ∧
    (∀ (B : Int), StepC c id B (toPState s) [] (toPState s')) ∧
      (s'.logst = s.logst ∧
          uint.Z s.term ≤ uint.Z s'.term ∧ uint.Z s'.term ≤ uint.Z s.term + 1 ∧ s'.prevote = s.prevote ∧ s'.gh = s.gh) ∧
        (¬id ∈ c.voters → s' = s) ∧ HupGuard c id s s'

def scanRange (ls : LogState) (lo hi : w64) : List EntryM :=
  List.take (uint.Z hi - uint.Z lo).toNat (plogFrom ls.prev (ls.sents ++ ls.uents) lo)

theorem HupGuard.precand [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {s s' :
    NState} (h : HupGuard c id s s') (hp : s'.role = PRole.preCandidate) : s'.term = s.term

def SnapScope (sv : SnapshotM) (cl : CSLists) : Prop :=
  have cs := sv.Metadata'.ConfState';
  CSWf cl.outgoing cl.voters cl.learners cl.learnersNext ∧
    cl.voters.Nodup ∧
      cl.learners.Nodup ∧
        cl.outgoing.Nodup ∧
          cl.learnersNext.Nodup ∧
            ↑cl.voters.length + ↑cl.learners.length + ↑cl.outgoing.length + ↑cl.learnersNext.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 ∧
              (cl.outgoing = [] → cs.AutoLeave' = false) ∧ uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' < 2 ^ 61

theorem SnapScopeIf.of_scope {id : w64} {sv : SnapshotM} {cl : CSLists} (h : SnapScope sv cl) :
    SnapScopeIf id sv cl
